description: Post-processing engine giving the capillary stress tensor<MeasureCapStress.sigmaCap> (the fluids mixture contribution to the total stress in unsaturated, i.e. triphasic, conditions) according to the $\mu$UNSAT expression detailled in [Duriez2017c]_. Although this expression differs in nature from...

attributes.name: sigmaCap
attributes.description: The capillary stress tensor $ boldsymbol{ sigma^{cap}}$ itself, expressed as $ boldsymbol{ sigma^{cap}} = 1/V , [ u_c ( boldsymbol{ mu_{Vw}} + boldsymbol{ mu_{Ssw}}) + gamma_{nw} ( boldsymbol{ mu_{Snw}} + boldsymbol{ mu_{ Gamma}}) ]$ where the four microstructure tensors $ boldsymbol{ mu_{Vw}}, boldsymbol{ mu_{Ssw}}, boldsymbol{ mu_{Snw}}, boldsymbol{ mu_{ Gamma}}$ correspond to

attributes.name: muVw
attributes.description: Tensorial contribution (spherical i.e. isotropic) to sigmaCap from the wetting fluid volume: $ boldsymbol{ mu_{Vw}} = V_w , boldsymbol{ delta}$ with $V_w =$ vW and $ boldsymbol{ delta}$ the identity tensor. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: muSsw
attributes.description: Tensorial contribution to sigmaCap from the wetted solid surfaces $Ssw$: $ boldsymbol{ mu_{Ssw}} = int_{Ssw} vec n otimes vec x dS$ with $ vec n$ the outward normal and $ vec x$ the position. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: muSnw
attributes.description: Tensorial contribution to sigmaCap from the wetting/non-wetting (e.g. liquid/gas) interface $S{nw}$: $ boldsymbol{ mu_{Snw}} = int_{Snw} ( boldsymbol delta - vec n otimes vec n) dS$ with $ vec n$ the outward normal and $ boldsymbol{ delta}$ the identity tensor. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: muGamma
attributes.description: Tensorial contribution to sigmaCap from the contact lines $ Gamma$: $ boldsymbol{ mu_{ Gamma}} = int_{ Gamma} vec nu_{nw} otimes vec x , dl$ with $ vec nu_{nw}$ the fluid-fluid interface conormal (Duriez2017c), and $ vec x$ the position. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: virtPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using virtual (simulation) time (deactivated if <= 0)

attributes.name: realPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using real (wall clock, computation, human) time in seconds (deactivated if <=0)

attributes.name: iterPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using step number (deactivated if <= 0)

attributes.name: nDo
attributes.description: Limit number of executions by this number (deactivated if negative)

attributes.name: initRun
attributes.description: Run the first time we are called as well.

attributes.name: firstIterRun
attributes.description: Sets the step number, at each an engine should be executed for the first time (disabled by default).

attributes.name: virtLast
attributes.description: Tracks virtual time of last run (auto-updated).

attributes.name: realLast
attributes.description: Tracks real time of last run (auto-updated).

attributes.name: iterLast
attributes.description: Tracks step number of last run (auto-updated).

attributes.name: nDone
attributes.description: Track number of executions (cummulative) (auto-updated).

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.
